verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS software platform for virtual mailboxes and mail centers, so asking whether its source is available under an open license is fair. Nothing in the evidence mentions a source repository, open-source license, or public code. The probes only show missing llms.txt and OpenAPI files, which do not bear on source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
